note: Fuzzer-controlled input size determines the allocation and later the in-memory filename bytes copied from the input.

The code assumes the filename contains at most one HTS index delimiter and later truncates the string at that position; the safety obligation is that the delimiter search and truncation must not leave an invalid filename path for downstream parsing.

The truncated filename is passed into the opener, which then parses the path and extension and can read past the end of the short buffer when the crafted delimiter placement confuses extension handling.
